summary.title: Technical Interview Guide for Busy Engineers | Tech Interview Handbook
summary.one_liner: A free, curated handbook that points software engineers to the minimum they need to know for technical interviews, covering resumes, coding and system design prep, behavioral questions, offer negotiation, and choosing a job.
keywords: what to study for a software engineering interview
takeaways: The handbook is organized in steps: resume, interview preparation, offer negotiation, and job preparation.
The Blind 75 list is presented as a short set of practice questions covering the most important topics.
Coverage includes algorithm tips, system design, behavioral questions, and company interview formats.
Related resources include Grind 75, a study plan tool, and the Front End Interview Handbook.
summary.summary: The Tech Interview Handbook is a free website aimed at busy software engineers who want the essentials for technical interviews without wading through everything. The page presents it as a step-by-step guide that covers resume preparation, coding and algorithm practice, system design, behavioral interviews, offer negotiation, and how to choose between companies and understand engineering levels. It recommends a curated set of practice questions (the Blind 75 list) and links to related tools such as Grind 75 and the Front End Interview Handbook. Much of the page is testimonials and advertising, so the concrete content is mainly the list of sections described above.
